gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, at EcoFlow's US store on 2026-11-15, the 2,048 Wh DELTA 3 Max ($879, $0.43/Wh) and the 3,072 Wh DELTA 3 Ultra ($1,299, $0.42/Wh) cost less per watt-hour than the 1,024 Wh DELTA 3 ($579, $0.57/Wh). The cheapest unit is therefore not the best value per Wh, and the 'Plus' versions add about $0.10–0.13/Wh.
standout_why: solarkontor.de (opened 2026-11-15) names the RIVER 2, RIVER 3 and DELTA 2, DELTA 3 and DELTA Pro lines but gives no per-model price, weight, cost per Wh, Wh per lb or solar refill hours. Its only time figure is a generic '2–8 hours' for solar charging. The tech.yahoo.com DELTA 3 Plus review returned 403, trailandkale.com returned 404 and shopsolarkits.com returned 429, so I could not check those three. The notebookcheck and REI results are launch news or a single product listing, so I did not open them.
decides: For a shopper who doesn't have to carry the unit far, these numbers point to the DELTA 3 Max (2 kWh, $879) or the DELTA 3 Ultra (3 kWh, $1,299, 800 W solar input, 72 lb) over the 1 kWh DELTA 3 or DELTA 3 Plus. For a carryable unit, the RIVER 2 Pro (768 Wh, 18.2 lb, $369) has the best mix: $0.48/Wh and 42 Wh/lb, about the same energy per pound as the DELTA 3 Ultra. The RIVER 2 (240) and RIVER 2 Max 500 cost $0.62–0.83/Wh.
